title: Australian Pilchard Pilaf
description: A hearty and nutritious Australian-inspired pilaf dish packed with pilchards and nourishing ingredients.

ingredients.name: Nourishing seeds
ingredients.notes: such as sesame or sunflower seeds

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the grated carrot and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the pilchards, pilaf seasoning, and nourishing seeds. Stir to combine.
Add the uncooked rice and stir to coat the rice with the oil and seasoning mixture.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
